description.value: Curry Express is a family-run quick-serve Indian food chain that has operated in Metro Vancouver since 1996, cooking with fresh meats and produce in Tandoor ovens, Karhais, and Tavas. The Lougheed Town Centre location sits inside a large suburban shopping mall and offers a broad menu of curries, biryanis, wraps, and street food of India. It would serve as a convenient meal stop for cyclists passing through the Burnaby/Coquitlam corridor.

address.value: Unit 248, 9855 Austin Rd, Burnaby, BC V3J 0B4
